messages.text: Hi — who's running this portfolio?
Thomas Suen. CS student, developer, photographer.
I build autonomous systems and over-engineered web toys.
Based where?
Vancouver, BC. Open to remote / relocation for the right team.
What's the elevator pitch?
I make one-person-team software: design, graphics, backend, deploy. Bias for shipping.

threads.title: Projects
threads.subtitle: Show me what you've shipped

messages.text: What are you most proud of?
Three things right now.
1. This portfolio — a full macOS sim with real windowing + vfs + scripted apps.
2. A Blender-MCP animation pipeline — agents keyframe products procedurally.
3. A batch of vertical agents (sales, ops, legal) over real enterprise data.
Which one do you want to talk about?
Pick one in Finder → Documents → Projects and open it. Or ask me here.

suggestions: Tell me about the Blender pipeline

messages.text: Are you looking for work?
Always listening. Favourite shape of engagement:
— Small team, high trust, real ownership
— Product-adjacent eng (graphics, agents, DX tooling)
— Contract or intern, remote-friendly
How do I reach you?
Open Mail and send something. Or email reunifylabs@gmail.com directly.
Something weird about you?
I edit photos on the same laptop I render 3D on. It protests.
I own too many mechanical keyboards.
My most-used key is Cmd+Tab.
Music while coding?
Lo-fi, drum & bass, or the Interstellar soundtrack on repeat.
